route: Shimla - The Ridge - Jakhu - Kufri - Fagu - Chandigarh
highlights: The Ridge, Christ Church and Mall Road
Jakhu Temple and Viceregal Lodge
Annandale, Lakkar Bazaar and Chadwick Falls
Green Valley, Kufri and Fagu orchards
overview: Explore Shimla over four days with Mall Road, heritage sights, Jakhu Temple and a Kufri excursion before departure to Chandigarh.
days: Arrival in Shimla & Exploration of Mall Road
Head out to The Ridge and the neo-Gothic Christ Church. Stroll down the pedestrian-only Mall Road, visit Scandal Point and Gaiety Theatre, and enjoy local dining or shopping at Lakkar Bazaar.
Shimla Local Sightseeing & Heritage Tour

Morning: Visit the high-altitude Jakhoo Temple (dedicated to Lord Hanuman), accessible via the Jakhoo Ropeway or a scenic walk. Next, explore the historic Indian Institute of Advanced Study (Viceregal Lodge). Afternoon: Visit the Army Museum at Annandale or the ancient Tara Devi Temple and Sankat Mochan Temple. Evening: Spend free time relaxing at a cafe on Mall Road or picking up wooden handicrafts and woolens. Overnight Stay: Hotel in Shimla
Excursion to Kufri & Green Valley

Morning: Take a short morning drive through the scenic Green Valley viewpoint toward Kufri (located about 15–16 km away). Afternoon: Explore Kufri’s main highlights, including the Himalayan Nature Park, Mahasu Peak (via horse riding or short trek), and nearby Fagu apple orchards. On your return route, you can optionally visit Chail or Naldehra if time permits. Evening: Return to Shimla for a relaxed dinner and final evening walk. Overnight Stay: Hotel in Shimla.
Departure from Shimla
Morning: Enjoy breakfast, check out of your hotel, and purchase last-minute souvenirs. Departure: Board your private cab, Volvo bus, or train back to Chandigarh
title: Shimla - Queen of Hills

highlights: Jakhu Temple and Viceregal Lodge
Green Valley and Himalayan Nature Park
Mahasu Peak and Kufri Fun World
Optional Chail or Fagu extension
route: Shimla - Green Valley - Kufri - Chail or Fagu - Chandigarh
overview: A three-day Shimla and Kufri break with heritage sightseeing, Green Valley, Mahasu Peak and an optional Chail or Fagu extension.
title: Kufri & Shimla Tour
days: Shimla Local Sightseeing & Heritage Tour

Morning: Visit the high-altitude Jakhoo Temple (dedicated to Lord Hanuman), accessible via the Jakhoo Ropeway or a scenic walk. Next, explore the historic Indian Institute of Advanced Study (Viceregal Lodge). Afternoon: Visit the Army Museum at Annandale or the ancient Tara Devi Temple and Sankat Mochan Temple. Evening: Spend free time relaxing at a cafe on Mall Road or picking up wooden handicrafts and woolens. Overnight Stay: Hotel in Shimla
Excursion to Kufri & Chail

Morning: After breakfast, drive from Shimla toward Kufri (about 16 km away, situated at an altitude of 2,501–2,622 meters). Stop briefly at Green Valley for scenic mountain photographs. Daytime Activities in Kufri: Visit the Himalayan Nature Park to spot local flora and fauna. Head to Mahasu Peak (reachable via a scenic horse/mule ride or light trek) for panoramic valley views. Enjoy rides and adventure games at Kufri Fun World or try skiing/tobogganing if you are visiting during the winter snow season. Afternoon / Extension: Proceed toward Chail for a quiet retreat surrounded by dense forests and royal heritage, or return via Fagu. Night Stay: Return to Shimla for your second night stay.
Morning Leisure & Departure
Morning: Enjoy a relaxed breakfast, check out from the hotel, and complete any last-minute local souvenir shopping. Departure: Depart from Shimla for your onward journey back to Chandigarh

highlights: Chail Palace and deodar forest walks
Kali Ka Tibba and Sidh Baba Temple
Chail Cricket Ground
Wildlife sanctuary or Sadhupul riverside visit
route: Chandigarh or Delhi - Chail - Kali Ka Tibba - Sadhupul - Chandigarh
overview: Spend three days in Chail visiting its palace, Kali Ka Tibba, cricket ground and forest trails, with a return journey to Chandigarh.
title: Chail Heritage & Nature Tour
days: Arrival and Leisurely Exploration in Chail

Morning / Afternoon: Arrive in Chail (via Chandigarh or Delhi), check into your hotel or heritage resort, and rest after the journey. Afternoon: Visit the historic Chail Palace, built in 1891 by the Maharaja of Patiala, famous for its classic royal furniture, antique interiors, and sprawling 75-acre grounds. Evening: Take a quiet walk through the surrounding deodar and pine forests or relax while enjoying the Himalayan sunset. Night: Enjoy a traditional Himachali dinner and stay overnight at your hotel.
Chail Sightseeing and Nature Trails

Morning: After breakfast, head to Kali Ka Tibba (Kali Temple) perched at the top of a hill, offering panoramic views of the Shivalik Hills and surrounding peaks. Mid-Day: Explore the Chail Cricket Ground—built in 1893 and known as the highest cricket pitch in the world (at 2,444 meters)—followed by a visit to the Sidh Baba Temple. Afternoon: Drive or walk through the Chail Wildlife Sanctuary (permits and ID required), or head down to Sadhupul to enjoy lunch by the riverside. Evening: Visit the local market near Chail Gurudwara Sahib to shop for handmade woolens or local souvenirs. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight rest.
Departure
Morning: Have a relaxed breakfast at the hotel and complete your check-out formalities. Afternoon: Depart from Chail and head back to Chandigarh

end: Return Volvo bus or private cab; drop-off by arrangement
highlights: Hadimba Devi Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road
Solang Valley ropeway and optional adventure sports
Vashisht Temple and hot springs
Optional Atal Tunnel, Sissu and Kullu excursion
route: Manali - Solang Valley - Vashisht - Atal Tunnel - Sissu - Kullu
overview: A four-day Manali and Solang Valley holiday with local temples, optional adventure sports and a weather-dependent Atal Tunnel and Sissu excursion.
start: Manali; arrival via Delhi or Chandigarh
title: Manali & Solang Valley
days: Arrival in Manali & Local Sightseeing

Journey / Arrival: Arrive in Manali (via Volvo bus from Delhi or a scenic cab ride from Chandigarh) and check into your hotel.  Visit the wooden Hadimba Devi Temple surrounded by cedar forests. Explore Old Manali for hippie alleys, mountain views, and cafe hopping. Walk down Mall Road for evening shopping and local food. Meals & Stay: Dinner and overnight stay at the Manali hotel.
Solang Valley & Adventure Activities

Drive: Morning drive of about 30 to 60 minutes from Manali to Solang Valley.  Indulge in optional adventure sports (at an extra cost) like paragliding, zorbing, skiing (seasonal), or ATV rides. Take a ride on the Solang Valley cable car / ropeway. Afternoon / Evening: Visit the Vashisht Temple and Hot Water Springs on the way back. Evening leisure back in Manali with a bonfire or music night at the hotel (if included). Meals & Stay: Breakfast and dinner at the hotel.
Atal Tunnel, Sissu & Kullu Excursion (Optional Extension)

Drive: Cross the engineering marvel of the Atal Tunnel (subject to vehicle permissions and weather) to reach Sissu village in Lahaul to see the Sissu Waterfall and snow-capped peaks. Side Trips: Stop by Kullu for river rafting on the Beas River or a visit to local shawl factories/Naggar Castle. Meals & Stay: Dinner and overnight stay in Manali.
Departure
Morning: Enjoy a relaxed breakfast, do final souvenir shopping around Mall Road or Van Vihar, and check out. Return: Board your return Volvo bus or private cab back

route: Kullu - Kasol - Manikaran - Tosh or Malana - Manali - Solang - Sissu - Kullu
highlights: Manikaran Sahib and hot springs
Parvati River, Kasol markets and cafes
Optional Tosh or Malana excursion
Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel and Sissu
Hadimba Temple, Club House and Tibetan Monastery
Optional Beas River rafting in Kullu
overview: Explore Kullu, Kasol and Manikaran before continuing to Manali, Solang Valley and Sissu on this four-day valley itinerary.
days: Arrival in Kullu – Transfer to Kasol via Manikaran

Arrive at Kullu (airport, railway station, or pickup point) or travel from Delhi/Chandigarh via Sundernagar and Pandoh Dam. Drive to Kasol and check into your hotel or campsite. Visit the sacred Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara and soak in the natural hot sulfur springs. Stroll along the Parvati River and explore Kasol's local market and cafes in the evening. Overnight stay in Kasol.
Kasol / Malana / Tosh Excursion or Drive to Manali

Option to trek or drive to the offbeat village of Malana or Tosh for panoramic Himalayan views and local culture. Afternoon drive from the Parvati Valley to Manali. En route stop at the Vaishno Devi Temple and local Kullu shawl/pashmina factories. Check-in at your Manali hotel and relax; evening visit to Mall Road. Overnight stay in Manali.
Manali Local Sightseeing & Solang Valley / Atal Tunnel

Morning trip to Solang Valley for snow views, ropeway rides, and adventure activities (paragliding, quad biking, or skiing depending on the season). Drive through the Atal Tunnel and visit Sissu Village and Sissu Waterfall in the Lahaul Valley. Return to Manali to visit the ancient Hadimba Temple, Club House, and Tibetan Monastery. Overnight stay in Manali.
Kullu River Rafting & Departure

Check out from the Manali hotel after breakfast. Head to Kullu for optional river rafting on the Beas River or paragliding. Explore local Kullu handicraft markets. Board your return Volvo bus, cab, or train back
start: Kullu pickup point or travel from Delhi / Chandigarh
title: Kullu & Kasol

route: Shimla - Sangla / Chitkul - Kalpa - Nako - Tabo - Dhankar - Kaza - Pin Valley - Chandratal - Manali
highlights: Sangla, Chitkul and Kalpa apple orchards
Khab confluence, Nako Lake and Tabo Monastery
Dhankar Monastery and Lake; Gue village
Key Monastery, Kibber and Chicham Bridge
Langza, Hikkim and Komic villages
Pin Valley, Kungri and Mudh
Kunzum Pass, Chandratal camping and Atal Tunnel
overview: Travel from Shimla to Manali on a nine-day Spiti circuit through Kinnaur, ancient monasteries, high villages, Pin Valley and Chandratal.
days: Shimla to Sangla / Chitkul
Drive from Shimla through the scenic Kinnaur Valley. Stop at Karcham and reach Chitkul, the last inhabited village near the Indo-Tibet border. Overnight stay in Chitkul or Sangla.
Chitkul to Kalpa
Drive to Kalpa via Reckong Peo. View the sacred Kaintal and Srikhand Mahadev peaks of the Kinnaur Kailash range. Visit the local temples and Apple orchards in Kalpa.
Kalpa to Nako and Tabo
Drive past the confluence (Sangam) of the Spiti and Sutlej rivers at Khab. Visit Nako Lake and Nako Monastery. Continue to Tabo and explore the 1,000-year-old Tabo Monastery (Ajanta of the Himalayas)
Tabo to Dhankar and Kaza
Visit the dramatic Dhankar Monastery and Dhankar Lake. Stop at the mummy monk in Gue Village. Arrive in Kaza, the sub-divisional headquarters of Spiti, and check in to your hotel or homestay.
Kaza – Key, Kibber, and Chicham Bridge
Visit the iconic Key Monastery perched on a hilltop. Head to Kibber village and cross the high-altitude Chicham Bridge (one of the highest bridges in Asia). Return to Kaza for the evening.
Kaza – Langza, Hikkim, and Komic
Drive to Langza Village to see the giant Buddha statue and marine fossils. Visit Hikkim, home to the world’s highest post office. Visit Komic, one of the highest motorable villages in the world.
Kaza to Pin Valley (Mudh Village) and back
Excursion to the lush Pin Valley National Park. Visit the hanging monastery in Kungri and reach Mudh, the last motorable village of Pin Valley. Return to Kaza for an evening walk in the local market.
Kaza to Chandratal Lake via Kunzum Pass

Drive from Kaza past Losar (the last village of Spiti Valley). Cross the high-altitude Kunzum Pass (4,590 meters). Trek or drive close to the crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake and camp overnight under the stars.
Chandratal to Manali
Drive from Chandratal through the rugged terrain of Lahaul. Pass through the Atal Tunnel and arrive in Manali to conclude the trip
title: Spiti Valley via Kinnaur

route: Chandigarh - Naina Devi - Chintpurni - Jwala Ji - Baglamukhi - Brajeshwari Devi - Chamunda Devi - Chandigarh
highlights: Shree Naina Devi Temple
Mata Chintpurni Temple
Mata Jwala Ji Temple
Baglamukhi Mata Temple, Bankhandi
Shri Brajeshwari Devi Temple, Kangra
Chamunda Devi Temple and aarti
overview: A three-day pilgrimage from Chandigarh connecting Naina Devi, Chintpurni, Jwala Ji, Baglamukhi, Brajeshwari Devi and Chamunda Devi.
days: Chandigarh to Naina Devi and Chintpurni

Morning: Depart from Chandigarh early (approx. 6:00 AM) and drive toward Shree Naina Devi Temple (use the cable car/ropeway for easy access). Afternoon: Proceed towards Una district to visit Mata Chintpurni Temple for darshan. Night: Drive or check into a hotel in Chintpurni or Jwala Ji for an overnight stay.
Jwala Ji, Baglamukhi, and Kangra (Brajeshwari Devi)

Morning: Head to Mata Jwala Ji Temple to witness the sacred eternal flames. Mid-Day: Visit Baglamukhi Mata Temple in Bankhandi for special prayers. Afternoon: Travel to Kangra to visit Shri Brajeshwari Devi Temple. Evening: Drive to Chamunda Devi Temple on the banks of the Baner River, attend the evening aarti, and stay overnight.
Chamunda Devi Morning Aarti & Return to Chandigarh
Morning: Attend the early morning darshan and aarti at Chamunda Devi Temple. Afternoon: Begin the return journey back
title: Himachal Pradesh - 6 Shakti Peeth

route: Amritsar - Attari-Wagah Border - Pathankot - Jammu - Katra - Vaishno Devi - Jammu
highlights: Attari-Wagah Border ceremony
Golden Temple and Jallianwala Bagh
Maharaja Ranjit Singh Summer Palace Museum
Mata Vaishno Devi yatra
overview: Combine Amritsar sightseeing and the Attari-Wagah ceremony with a Katra stay and Vaishno Devi pilgrimage over four days.
days: Arrival in Amritsar & Wagah Border

Morning/Afternoon: Arrive at Amritsar Airport or Railway Station, meet your driver, and check in to your hotel. Late Afternoon: Drive to the Indo-Pak Attari-Wagah Border (approx. 30 km from the city) to watch the energetic Beating the Retreat flag ceremony. Night: Return to Amritsar for dinner and an overnight hotel stay.
Golden Temple & Drive to Katra

Morning: Visit the spiritual Golden Temple (Harmandir Sahib), Jallianwala Bagh, and the Maharaja Ranjit Singh Summer Palace Museum. Afternoon: Check out and drive by AC vehicle or cab toward Katra via Pathankot and Jammu (approx. 249 km, taking roughly 5–6 hours). Night: Arrive in Katra, check in to your hotel, and rest or explore the local market.
Mata Vaishno Devi Yatra

Morning to Evening: Begin the 12 km to 13.5 km trek (one way) from Banganga to the Holy Shrine of Mata Vaishno Devi, or opt for alternative transit like a pony, Palki, battery car, or helicopter. Night: Complete your darshan and return down to Katra by late evening for an overnight hotel stay.
Departure
Morning: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel, check out, and drive toward Jammu Airport, Jammu Tawi Railway Station, or back
title: Amritsar - Katra
end: Jammu Airport, Jammu Tawi Railway Station or return by arrangement

route: Pathankot - Dalhousie - Chamera Lake - Khajjiar - Kalatop
highlights: Gandhi Chowk, Mall Road, St. Johns Church and Subhash Baoli
Panchpula and Satdhara Waterfalls
Chamera Lake and optional Dainkund visit
Khajjiar Lake and Khajji Nag Temple
Kalatop Wildlife Sanctuary; optional Chamba visit
overview: Explore Dalhousie, Chamera Lake, Khajjiar and Kalatop on a four-day mountain holiday. Departure-day arrangements are confirmed on enquiry.
days: Arrival in Dalhousie & Local Sightseeing

Route / Travel: Arrive via Pathankot Railway Station or Airport (approx. 3 hours / 75 km to Dalhousie) or an overnight drive from Delhi.  Check into your hotel in Dalhousie and freshen up. Visit Gandhi Chowk and Mall Road for an evening stroll. Explore historic local sites like St. John’s Church and Subhash Baoli. Meals & Stay: Dinner and overnight stay at a hotel in Dalhousie.
Dalhousie Waterfalls & Chamera Lake

Morning breakfast at the hotel. Visit Panchpula and Satdhara Waterfalls, known for their natural beauty and scenic surroundings. Head to Chamera Lake for boating and panoramic views. Optional trek or visit to Dainkund Peak (the highest point in Dalhousie) for sunset views. Meals & Stay: Dinner and overnight stay in Dalhousie.
Khajjiar & Kalatop Wildlife Sanctuary

After breakfast, drive from Dalhousie toward Khajjiar (approx. 25 km away), famously known as the "Mini Switzerland of India". Explore Khajjiar Lake and the ancient Khajji Nag Temple. Try adventure activities like zorbing or paragliding in the grassy meadows. Stop at the Kalatop Khajjiar Wildlife Sanctuary for a peaceful walk through dense deodar, pine, and fir forests. Visit the neighboring town of Chamba (about 21 km from Khajjiar) to see historic temples and local handicraft markets if time permits. Meals & Stay: Return to Dalhousie for dinner and overnight stay (or stay overnight in Khajjiar if booked on a customized plan).
start: Pathankot Railway Station or Airport, or travel from Delhi
title: Dalhousie - Khajjiar
itinerary_note: This is a 4-day / 3-night tour. Sightseeing is detailed for Days 1-3; please enquire to confirm Day 4 and departure arrangements.

start: Gaggal Airport, Pathankot Railway Station or Volvo arrival from Delhi / Chandigarh
days: Arrival in Dharamshala & Local Sightseeing

Morning / Arrival: Arrive in Dharamshala (via Gaggal Airport, Pathankot Railway Station, or Volvo bus from Delhi/Chandigarh) and check in to your hotel.  HPCA Cricket Stadium: One of the highest and most scenic cricket grounds in the world. War Memorial: Set amidst pine forests honoring war heroes. Kangra Tea Gardens: Walk through lush green tea estates. Evening: Stroll through Kotwali Bazaar or local markets in Lower Dharamshala for local snacks and crafts. Overnight Stay: Dharamshala / McLeod Ganj hotel.
McLeod Ganj & Bhagsu Exploration

Morning: Head up to McLeod Ganj (the spiritual hub of Tibetan Buddhism). Dalai Lama Temple Complex (Tsuglagkhang Complex): Visit the main temple, stupas, and prayer wheels. Tibetan Museum: Learn about the history and struggle of Tibet. Afternoon: Bhagsunag Temple & Bhagsu Waterfall: A short, refreshing walk to the cascading waterfall. St. John in the Wilderness Church: A historic neo-Gothic stone church surrounded by deodar trees. Evening: Visit Dal Lake and watch the sunset or enjoy panoramic views from Naddi Village / Viewpoint. Spend the evening café-hopping or shopping for Tibetan handicrafts, singing bowls, and woolen clothes at the McLeod Ganj Main Square. Overnight Stay: McLeod Ganj
title: Dharamshala - McLeod Ganj
overview: Discover Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj through Tibetan heritage, Bhagsu Waterfall, tea gardens and Naddi views. Ask for the remaining days of the existing five-day trip, including Dharamkot and Triund.
highlights: HPCA Cricket Stadium, War Memorial and Kangra Tea Gardens
Dalai Lama Temple Complex and Tibetan Museum
Bhagsunag Temple and Bhagsu Waterfall
St. John in the Wilderness Church
Dal Lake, Naddi views and McLeod Ganj markets
Dharamkot and Triund extension: schedule on enquiry
itinerary_note: The existing package is 5 days / 4 nights. Days 1-2 are detailed here; please enquire to confirm Days 3-5, the Dharamkot and Triund extension, and departure arrangements.

route: Pathankot - Nurpur - Dharamshala - McLeod Ganj - Kangra - Pathankot
highlights: Nurpur Fort and Krishna Meera Temple
Dalai Lama Temple and Tibetan monasteries
Bhagsunag Temple and waterfall
Dal Lake, Naddi and St. John in the Wilderness
HPCA Stadium and War Memorial
Kangra Fort and Brajeshwari Devi Temple
overview: A three-day heritage circuit from Pathankot via Nurpur Fort, Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj to Kangra Fort and its temples.
days: Pathankot to Dharamshala (via Nurpur)

Pickup: Early morning arrival at Pathankot Railway Station or Bus Stand. Nurpur Fort & Temple: Drive toward Dharamshala (approx. 90 km) and stop at Nurpur Fort (named after Nur Jahan) and the unique Krishna Meera Temple (the only temple in India dedicated to the Krishna-Meera jodi). Arrival & Check-in: Reach Dharamshala/McLeodganj, check in to your hotel, and rest. Evening: Stroll through the vibrant McLeodganj Market. Overnight Stay: Hotel in Dharamshala or McLeodganj.
Dharamshala & McLeodganj Sightseeing

Morning: Breakfast at the hotel, then head out for local sightseeing.  Dalai Lama Temple (Tsuglagkhang Complex) & Tibetan Monasteries. Bhagsunag Waterfall and the ancient Bhagsunag Temple. Dal Lake and scenic viewpoints at Naddi. St. John in the Wilderness Church. HPCA Cricket Stadium and the War Memorial. Overnight Stay: Hotel in Dharamshala.
Dharamshala – Kangra (Fort & Temples) – Return to Pathankot

Morning: Check out after breakfast and drive toward Kangra Valley.  Explore the historic Kangra Fort (one of the oldest and largest forts in India). Visit the revered Mata Shri Bajreshwari Devi Temple in Kangra or Chamunda Devi Temple (if time permits). Stop by local tea gardens or craft/art galleries if schedule allows. Departure: Drive back to Pathankot
start: Pathankot Railway Station or Bus Stand, early morning
title: Pathankot - Nurpur - Dharamshala - Kangra
